lines.en: Good afternoon, Marina. What do you need today?

lines.es: Hola. Una docena de huevos, por favor.
lines.en: Hi. A dozen eggs, please.
Here you are. Anything else?

lines.es: Sí, un kilo de patatas y una cebolla.
lines.en: Yes, a kilo of potatoes and an onion.
Are you going to make an omelette?

lines.es: ¡Sí! Esta noche viene una amiga a cenar.
lines.en: Yes! A friend is coming for dinner tonight.
How nice! With onion or without?
With onion, of course.

lines.es: Un consejo: dale la vuelta con un plato grande.
lines.en: A tip: flip it with a big plate.
Thanks. I'm a bit nervous.

lines.es: No te preocupes. ¡Te va a salir muy bien!
lines.en: Don't worry. It's going to turn out great!
How much is it?
Four euros twenty. Enjoy your meal!
Hi, Marina! Am I early?
No, you're right on time! Come in, come in.

lines.es: Mira, he traído una tarta de queso para el postre.
lines.en: Look, I've brought a cheesecake for dessert.
How lovely! Did you make it?

lines.es: Sí, es la receta de mi abuela.
lines.en: Yes, it's my grandmother's recipe.
Thanks! But I have to tell you something…
What's wrong?

lines.es: La tortilla se ha roto. ¡Qué apuro!
lines.en: The omelette has broken. How embarrassing!
Ha ha! Don't worry.
But I wanted a perfect dinner…

lines.es: Una tortilla rota también está rica.
lines.en: A broken omelette is tasty too.

lines.es: Tienes razón. ¿Me ayudas con la ensalada?
lines.en: You're right. Will you help me with the salad?
Of course! Where's the apron?
Well, dinner is ready. Sit down!
Everything looks so good!
There's gazpacho, omelette and salad.
Then… let's make a toast!
To our cooking class!
Cheers! And… enjoy your meal!
You too!
Mmm, the omelette is delicious.
Really? Isn't it too dry?

lines.es: No, está perfecta. ¿Me pasas el pan?
lines.en: No, it's perfect. Can you pass me the bread?
Here. Do you want more gazpacho?

lines.es: Sí, un poco más, por favor.
lines.en: Yes, a bit more, please.

lines.es: ¡Me alegro mucho de que te guste!
lines.en: I'm so glad you like it!

convs.title: 4 · Con la vecina en la escalera

lines.es: Buenos días, Marina. ¡Anoche había mucha alegría en tu casa!
lines.en: Good morning, Marina. There was a lot of fun at your place last night!
Oh, sorry! Did we make a lot of noise?

lines.es: No, no te preocupes. Solo risas.
lines.en: No, don't worry. Just laughter.

lines.es: Es que vino mi amiga Laura a cenar.
lines.en: It's just that my friend Laura came for dinner.
How nice! And what did you cook?

lines.es: Gazpacho y tortilla… pero la tortilla se rompió.
lines.en: Gazpacho and omelette… but the omelette broke.

lines.es: ¡Ja, ja! A mí me pasa siempre.
lines.en: Ha ha! It always happens to me.
Really? And what do you do?

lines.es: Uso una sartén pequeña y mucho aceite.
lines.en: I use a small frying pan and lots of oil.
Thanks for the tip!

lines.es: De nada. ¿Me guardas un poco la próxima vez?
lines.en: You're welcome. Will you save me some next time?

lines.es: ¡Claro! Ahora tengo un poco en la nevera.
lines.en: Of course! I have a little in the fridge right now.

lines.es: ¡Qué amable eres! ¡Buen provecho para mí, entonces!
lines.en: How kind you are! Enjoy my meal, then! (joke)

narr.intro: [excited] Welcome! [cheerfully] Today, practise real conversations from Marina's dinner for Laura! [warmly] First listen... then repeat each line.
narr.c1: [cheerfully] Conversation one: at the corner shop!
narr.c4: [cheerfully] Conversation four: with the neighbour on the stairs!
narr.outro: [excited] Well done! [warmly] See you next week!
